lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters organized in roughly five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns across the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a lattice-like pattern across the mid-section of the shark's flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible; the central ridge shows a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity pixels on the dorsal edge and a deep shadow gradient on the ventral edge, spanning the length of the visible flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 5-7 high-luminance blobs localized primarily on the posterior half of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density cluster of smaller, irregular high-luminance spots along its dorsal surface, distinct from the more uniform grid on the primary flank.
